candidate.summary: A separately staged triple-receptor programme for obesity or overweight. The Phase 2 registry records 344 actual participants and an actual start on 30 June 2026; completion dates remain estimates and no results are posted.

candidate.nhsAccess: Not established by the reviewed evidence.
